precondition_sources.text: The matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (e.g., base = 256 and quote in {1..255}, or 40 & 21).
The matched base amount is a power-of-two 2^k and the matched quote is any value less than 2^k.

intent_sources.text: The zero-cost trade guard must reject only trades where one side receives tokens without sending any, not legitimate trades whose matched amounts have disjoint bits.
